author: riverlijunjie
title: GPU Windows build fails: illegal qualified name xe3p_35_10/xe3p_35_11/xe3p_unknown in moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp
signature: illegal qualified name in member declaration undeclared identifier xe3p|Code Issue
key_errors: moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp(29): error C2838: 'xe3p_35_10': illegal qualified name in member declaration
moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp(30): error C2838: 'xe3p_35_11': illegal qualified name in member declaration
moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp(31): error C2838: 'xe3p_unknown': illegal qualified name in member declaration
moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp(29): error C2051: case expression not constant
root_cause: The PR #35433 modified src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl_v2/moe/moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp and introduced xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, xe3p_unknown identifiers that are undeclared on MSVC (Windows). These identifiers are GPU architecture enum values likely missing from a header or guard clause, causing MSVC to reject them with C2838 (illegal qualified name) and C2065 (undeclared identifier). The build is configured with -DCMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR=ON so the error is fatal.
reproduction_steps: Build openvino on Windows with VS 2022 Debug configuration; the error is deterministic in the modified file.
recommended_actions: Check that xe3p_35_10, xe3p_35_11, xe3p_unknown enum values are defined in the header included by moe_3gemm_gen_micro.cpp on Windows
Ensure any new GPU architecture enum values are guarded or available cross-platform
Fix the code and push a new commit to PR #35433
prevention_strategies: Run Windows CI locally or ensure cross-platform compilation checks cover new GPU arch enum additions.
historical_context: No prior occurrences of this specific error pattern found.
